name: Anthropic
tagline: The safety-first frontier lab that out-raised and out-valued every private company on earth
shortSummary: Anthropic is the San Francisco frontier lab behind the Claude model family, founded in 2021 by Dario Amodei and colleagues who left OpenAI over safety. It pairs a safety mission with the most aggressive capital accumulation in private-market history.

facts.label: Sector
facts.value: Frontier AI safety & research (Claude model family)

rounds.label: Series A
rounds.note: Led by AI-safety investor Jaan Tallinn two months after founding.

rounds.label: Series B
rounds.note: ~US$500M (~86%) came from Alameda Research, the FTX-affiliated trading firm; the FTX estate later sold the stake at auction to repay creditors.

rounds.label: Google Strategic
rounds.note: First strategic Google investment (~10% stake) alongside a cloud relationship — the first of Anthropic's dual-hyperscaler commitments.

rounds.label: Series C
rounds.note: Existing and new institutional investors joined as Claude gained enterprise traction.

rounds.label: Amazon Strategic I
rounds.note: First tranche of Amazon's US$4B commitment, announced with a cloud and Trainium partnership.

rounds.label: Series D
rounds.note: Menlo Ventures led the round that began its bet-the-firm Anthropic relationship.

rounds.label: Amazon Strategic II
rounds.note: Second Amazon tranche toward its US$8B total commitment.

rounds.label: Amazon Strategic III
rounds.note: Amazon completed its US$8B total commitment across the 2023–2024 tranches.

rounds.label: Series E
rounds.note: Lightspeed led; the start of Anthropic's 2025 valuation acceleration.

rounds.label: Series F
rounds.note: Co-led by ICONIQ, Fidelity and Lightspeed; Qatar Investment Authority participated — sovereign wealth entered the cap table at scale.

rounds.label: Series G
rounds.note: Co-led by GIC and Coatue with a broader co-lead group. Term sheet signed at US$350B in December 2025, closed at US$380B in February 2026.

rounds.label: Series H
rounds.note: The largest private AI funding round in history at close, briefly making Anthropic the most valuable private company on earth ahead of OpenAI and SpaceX. Hardware makers Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron joined as strategic investors; includes ~US$15B of previously committed hyperscaler tranches. (Some tables list only the incremental ~US$8B new equity tranche; the widely reported headline is US$65B.)

sections.heading: Built on an OpenAI Split
sections.body: Dario and Daniela Amodei left OpenAI in 2021 with a group of researchers over disagreements on safety and commercialization, founding Anthropic around the principle of 'Constitutional AI' — models steered by principles rather than pure RLHF. The founding team's credibility produced a US$124M Series A within two months and a US$580M Series B led by FTX's Alameda Research the following year, a stake the FTX estate later sold at auction.

sections.heading: Two Hyperscalers, Not One
sections.body: Unlike most frontier labs, Anthropic holds strategic commitments from both Google (~US$43B cumulative by 2026, with a US$10B immediate tranche announced April 2026) and Amazon (US$8B), pairing Google Cloud TPUs and Amazon Trainium/Inferentia compute with massive cloud credits. The dual structure keeps leverage over any single cloud provider and lets Anthropic auction compute across suppliers.

sections.heading: The Fifteen-month Valuation Ladder
sections.body: The defining fact of Anthropic's financing history is its pace: US$61.5B (March 2025) → US$183B (September 2025) → US$380B (February 2026) → US$965B (May 2026), a ~16x expansion in fifteen months. Each round roughly doubled or tripled the previous post-money, and Series H's US$965B briefly surpassed OpenAI (US$852B) and SpaceX to make Anthropic the most valuable private company in the world.

sections.heading: Revenue to Back the Valuation
sections.body: By May 2026 Anthropic reported ~US$47B annualized revenue with 500+ customers each spending over US$1M a year — enterprise penetration (Claude in law, finance, healthcare and code) rather than consumer scale is the revenue engine behind the round sizes.

sections.heading: The IPO Staging Ground
sections.body: Anthropic confidentially filed its S-1 in June 2026 at a US$965B valuation. The Series H syndicate — growth funds plus Samsung/SK Hynix/Micron — positions the company for a public debut that would test whether the most valuable private company on earth can hold its multiple in public markets.
